ma.createTimer(number duration)

Execute the countdown function based on the input parameter duration, and notify the developer via the success callback when the countdown is complete (minimum version: 25.9.0)

Supported only on iOS.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
duration Number Yes Unit: seconds, initial countdown time of the timer
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.success
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String createTimer: ok
object.fail
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message

Sample Code

ma.createTimer({
    duration: 10,
    success: (res) => {
        ma.showModal({
            title: 'createTimer success',
            content: JSON.stringify(res),
            showCancel: false
        })
    },
    fail: (res) => {
        ma.showModal({
            title: 'createTimer fail',
            content: JSON.stringify(res),
            showCancel: false
        })
    }
})

Tips

  1. In iOS 18 and above, the timer may become invalid due to automatic thread recycling. If setTimeout or setInterval is used in the code, please replace ma.createTimer to ensure the timing effect.
